source.title: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 4 October 1946, p. 3 ("Elections: Ballymoney Rural Council")
source.publisher: Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Kirkmoyle result from the Belfast News-Letter (5 October 1946, p. 3) and Belfast Telegraph (4 October 1946, p. 7); Dervock return from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (4 October 1946, p. 3).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Only Kirkmoyle was contested; Dervock was also reported as a contest at the nominations but was not polled, its return not being printed, so it is left out here. The remaining divisions were unopposed. David McCaw withdrew, leaving Morrison the only candidate; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
